name: Arms of Hadar

source.note: Not in the free 2024 Basic Rules; written from knowledge of the 2024 PHB and cross-checked against aidedd.org's 2024 entry. Level, school, classes, casting time, range, components, duration and Concentration match the D&D Beyond 2024 spell list.

summary: 10-foot Emanation: Str save or 2d6 Necrotic and no Reactions until its next turn; half damage on a success.
text: Dark tendrils burst out of you. Each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from you makes a Strength saving throw. On a failure it takes 2d6 Necrotic damage and can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn; on a success it takes half as much damage and nothing else. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1.
